test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 2 (Held On: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: english
question:
Given below are four jumbled sentences. Select the option that gives their correct order.

A. I went over with other curious sightseers to look at it.

B. One evening a meteor fell near our suburban house.

C. Only one end of its roughly cylindrical shape was visible.

D. In size it had a diameter of about thirty yards.
solution:
The correct answer is **'BACD'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Once we go through the sentences, it can be easily assessed that the **whole detail is about a falling meteor.**

 
 
• The very first sentence that is **stating about falling meteor** is **'B' (One evening a meteor fell near our suburban house).**
 
• What happened **next can be seen in the sentence** **'A' (I went over with other curious sightseers to look at it).**
 
• When the person went there, **he described the meteor. It is mentioned** in the sentence **'C' (Only one end of its roughly cylindrical shape was visible).**
 
• So **obviously the last sentence** must be **'D' ( In size it had a diameter of about thirty yards).**
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct answer is **option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**Let's **understand meaning **of some given words.

 
• **Meteor - falling star, a shooting star.**
 
• **Suburban - residential.**
 
• **Sightseers - people who go sightseeing.**
